searches.question: What is the current compilation of the Residential Tenancies Act 1987, and is 07-a0-00 marked Current?
searches.route: WA Legislation landing page https://www.legislation.wa.gov.au/legislation/statutes.nsf/law_a693.html (curl, browser User-Agent), then the mrdoc_49316 docx, pdf and htm through RedirectURL
searches.note: Consolidated version 07-a0-00, currency start 29 Apr 2026, 'Current'; Act No. 128 of 1987, assent 21 Jan 1988; portfolio Minister for Commerce; agency Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety.

searches.question: Which versions of the Act exist, and is any later than 07-a0-00?
searches.route: versions page law_a693_currencies.html (curl)

searches.question: Which amendments have commenced, and are any uncommenced?
searches.route: the compilation's endnotes (compilation table, editorial changes table) and the history table law_a693_table1.docx (curl)
searches.note: No uncommenced provisions table in 07-a0-00; every amending Act listed has commenced. The two tables agree on every Act affecting the scope.

searches.question: Is any Bill before Parliament amending the Act or the Regulations?
searches.route: WA Legislation tablesbills.html, then Table 11 (by principal Acts) and Table 12 (by Bills), docx (curl)
searches.note: Tables last updated 17 Sep 2026. One Bill amends the Act: Residential Tenancies Amendment (Rent Cap) Bill 2026 (No. 70-1). None amends the Regulations. The Bill's text was not fetched (see SRCH-13).

searches.question: What subsidiary legislation is made under the Act, and what is the current compilation of the Regulations?
searches.route: law_a693_subsidiary.html, then the Regulations' landing page law_s4744.html and versions page law_s4744_currencies.html, then mrdoc_49840 docx and pdf (curl)
searches.note: The Residential Tenancies Regulations 1989 are the only subsidiary legislation in force under the Act; 05-ad0-00, currency start 3 Sep 2026, 'Current'.

searches.question: Which amending regulations made the in-scope regulations as they now stand?
searches.route: law_a693_subsidiary.html 'As made' list; SL 2026/4 (law_s55251, mrdoc_49175), SL 2026/182 (law_s56112, mrdoc_49834) and SL 2024/149 (law_s54887, mrdoc_47538), docx (curl); the Regulations' compilation table
searches.note: SL 2026/4 Pt 3 inserted rr. 5CB, 7F, 11A, 12I and amended rr. 5B and 10A (in force 28 Mar 2026). SL 2026/182 deleted r. 5AAA (in force 3 Sep 2026). SL 2024/149 (in force 29 Jul 2024; docx sha256 5853723419a4c8f96059549f23c003f31021b1626be765bae62238f512e8a751) amends only out-of-scope regulations (pets, modifications, s. 27B information, forms); read and not held.

searches.question: What did the Residential Tenancies Amendment Act 2024 enact?
searches.route: landing page law_a147426.html, then mrdoc_47004 docx and pdf (curl)
searches.note: No. 11 of 2024, assent 22 Apr 2024, as passed 00-00-00. The landing page links the Bill's progress page on parliament.wa.gov.au.

searches.question: When did each provision of the 2024 Act commence, in particular the rent-increase provisions (ss. 25-27)?
searches.route: law_a147426_subsidiary.html (the Act's proclamations), the three proclamations' docx (mrdoc_47087, 47540, 49239) and their landing pages law_s54845, law_s54927, law_s55252 for the publication dates (curl)
searches.note: ss. 25-28 commenced 29 Jul 2024 (SL 2024/143 cl. 2(f)), confirmed. ss. 4, 5, 17, 21-23, 24(1), 34, 36 and 55 commenced 16 May 2024 (SL 2024/75, published 15 May 2024, operative the next day); ss. 24(2)-(5) and 43 on 28 Mar 2026 (SL 2026/31). Per-section detail in the rtaa-2024 note.

searches.question: Which Act inserted ss. 64, 70A and 76C, and what did it say as passed?
searches.route: WA Legislation Acts as passed index aspassed_r.html, then law_a146871.html&view=asmade, then mrdoc_23067 pdf, doc and htm (curl)
searches.note: Residential Tenancies Amendment Act 2011, No. 60 of 2011: s. 63 (replacing ss. 63-64), s. 68 (s. 70A), s. 74 (ss. 76A-76C). Commencement 1 Jul 2013, from the compilation table; the commencement Gazettes were not fetched.

searches.question: Where are the explanatory memoranda and second reading speeches for the Residential Tenancies Amendment Bill 2023?
searches.route: one plain curl request (browser User-Agent) to https://www.parliament.wa.gov.au/parliament/bills.nsf/BillProgressPopup?openForm&ParentUNID=D2445F24656C17C848258A7500095AF6, as briefed
searches.note: Not refused: HTTP 200 with the real page (Azure front door, no challenge). The page lists the stages and links the two Bill prints, both EMs, both second reading speeches, the blue Bills, LC SNP No. 140 issues 1-4 and four messages. The brief permitted further plain requests only while the host did not refuse; see SRCH-11 to SRCH-13.

searches.question: What did the 2023 Bill say as introduced and as passed by the Assembly?
searches.route: parliament.wa.gov.au bills.nsf links Bill%2B140-1.pdf and Bill%2B140-2.pdf (plain curl)
searches.note: Both HTTP 200, PDF. The prints differ only in proposed s. 99 (amended in consideration in detail, 21 Feb 2024) and pagination.

searches.question: Where are the explanatory memorandum, second reading speeches and committee material for the Residential Tenancies Amendment Bill 2011?
searches.route: the Bill link on law_a146871.html, i.e. parliament.wa.gov.au BillProgressPopup ParentUNID=96B8AEE2DD8103744825789400221E67, then bills.nsf links EM%2B199-1.pdf, EM%2B199-1.002.pdf and the Standing Committee on Uniform Legislation and Statutes Review Report No. 65 (plain curl)
searches.note: All HTTP 200. The two EM links (Assembly, Council) serve byte-identical files. The Bill was referred to the Uniform Legislation and Statutes Review Committee (Report 65, tabled 1 Nov 2011).

searches.question: Can the 2011 Bill's second reading speeches be fetched from Hansard?
searches.route: parliament.wa.gov.au/Hansard/hansard.nsf/0/7BC449BB8ABF342C48257896002E1F3C/$FILE/A38 S1 20110518 p3584b-3585a.pdf (one plain curl request)
searches.note: HTTP 403: an Azure WAF page that requires JavaScript. As briefed, nothing else was tried on parliament.wa.gov.au after this: not the Council speech (C38 S1 20110907 p6891b-6892a.pdf), not the 2023 Bill's blue Bills, SNPs or messages, not the 2011 Bill print, SNP or messages, and not the Rent Cap Bill 2026. The two 2011 speeches are entered as hansard-la-2r-2011-05-18 and hansard-lc-2r-2011-09-07, not held, requested from the human before 3H.

searches.question: Explanatory memoranda and second reading speeches for the 2023 Bill, as supplied by the human
searches.route: supplied by the human (Michael Andrew Fairweather), downloaded through a browser on 2026-10-04 from the links on the Bill progress page and relayed by the coordinator; copied from C:\Users\micha\Downloads (EM+140-1.pdf, EM+140-2.pdf, 'A41 S1 20231129 p6755c-6757a.pdf', 'C41 S1 20240227 p390b-392a.pdf'), originals left in place
searches.note: Held in sources/internal/ with a pdftotext -layout text beside each; each copy's sha256 equals its original's. The file names match the Bill progress page links.

searches.question: Is there government review material behind the 2024 rent reforms (a Decision Regulatory Impact Statement)?
searches.route: web search 'Residential Tenancies Act review Decision Regulatory Impact Statement Western Australia rent increases once every 12 months', then consumerprotection.wa.gov.au publication pages and PDFs (curl), and the review page /residential-tenancies-act-review
searches.note: DRIS 1 (published May 2023) and DRIS 2 (January 2026, published May 2026). Both fingerprinted, not held (terms of use, SRCH-18). commerce.wa.gov.au now redirects to consumerprotection.wa.gov.au.

searches.question: What guidance does Consumer Protection give on rent increases, and where are the approved notice forms?
searches.route: web search 'Consumer Protection WA rent increases residential tenancy 12 months notice 60 days lessor', then the WA Rent Reforms page and the Form 10 and Form 11 PDF and Word files (curl)
searches.note: The approved forms for s. 30 (Form 10) and s. 31A (Form 11) notices. Fingerprinted, not held.

searches.question: When and by whom were the Form 10 and Form 11 notices approved?
searches.route: web searches for the Form 10 and Form 11 publication pages, then consumerprotection.wa.gov.au/publications/rent-increase-notice-form-10 and /rent-increase-notice-based-income-form-11 (curl)
searches.note: Form 10 states it was approved by the Commissioner for Consumer Protection under s. 88C (July 2024). Form 11 carries no approval statement; no instrument or notice of approval of either form was found. Both pages 'Last updated: 20 November 2024'.

searches.question: On what terms may consumerprotection.wa.gov.au material be copied?
searches.route: the 'Terms of use' link on consumerprotection.wa.gov.au pages, https://www.wa.gov.au/terms-of-use (curl)
searches.note: Copying permitted 'for your own personal use, for non-commercial educational purposes or for non-commercial use within your organisation', with attribution; no commercial reproduction without written permission. Not CC BY. Hence those documents are held by link and fingerprint only.

searches.question: On what terms may WA Legislation material be copied?
searches.route: https://www.legislation.wa.gov.au/legislation/statutes.nsf/copyright.html (curl)
searches.note: CC BY 4.0 for the State's material on the site, with an attribution notice ('Sourced from the Western Australian Legislation website at [date]...'); excluded: coat of arms, logos, trade marks, third-party material, the Government Gazette.

searches.question: What did Queensland's s. 93 (minimum period between rent increases) say after 1 July 2023?
searches.route: legislation.qld.gov.au: view/html/inforce/2023-07-01/act-2008-073 (a script-driven shell), then view/whole/html/inforce/2023-07-01/act-2008-073 and view/pdf/inforce/2023-07-01/act-2008-073 (curl)
searches.note: Reprint 'Current as at 1 July 2023' (CC BY 4.0). Extract of ss. 91-93 and s. 575 held; the whole PDF fingerprinted.

searches.question: What does Queensland's s. 93 say now, after the 2024 amending Act, and when did that commence?
searches.route: legislation.qld.gov.au: view/html/inforce/current/act-2008-073, view/whole/html/inforce/2026-08-17/act-2008-073, view/pdf/inforce/current/act-2008-073 and the legislative history view/html/inforce/current/act-2008-073/lh (curl)
searches.note: Reprint 'Current as at 17 August 2026'. s. 93 amended by Act No. 27 of 2024 s. 15 (assent 6 Jun 2024; Part 2 other than Division 3 on assent). The 1 Jul 2023 rule came from Act No. 8 of 2023 s. 58C (pt 4A, 1 Jul 2023). Extract of ss. 91-93B and ss. 577-579 held.

searches.question: Which Interpretation Act text governs time, months and service, and is it still current?
searches.route: the WA jurisdiction reference set subjects/au/wa/_jurisdiction/reference-set.json (item wa-interpretation-act-1984), then its landing page law_a384.html (curl)
searches.note: 07-k0-00 (mrdoc_49111) is still marked Current on 2026-10-04, so the 0H item stands.
